description: Scenario: maintainer adds a new POST entry point and must decide which dedup check to call. pipeline.rs::check_duplicate_msgid is called as step 3 of run_post_pipeline in lifecycle.rs. An identical msgid-map lookup is also performed inside write_article_to_ipfs and write_ipld_article_to_ipfs in post/ipfs_write.rs. The two paths are not coordinated; a future refactor could inadvertently remove one while leaving the other, resulting in either duplicate IPFS writes or a missing dedup gate depending on which copy is kept.
title: Duplicate dedup logic in pipeline.rs and ipfs_write.rs — unclear authoritative gate
